Old German street names in Breslau/Wroclaw

From different sources we tried to make a comprehensive overview of old German street names in Breslau/Wroclaw. We hope that this list is a good addition to our post about Genealogy in Wroclaw and Lower Silesia and could help you to find some traces of your family history!

Of course we cannot guarantee that these are the latest street names, as in the last decades street names were changed – but the list should be fairly accurate. If you have further hints then please use the comment box at the bottom of this page!

If you are planning a trip to Wroclaw, then our blog is full of useful resources, no matter if our recommendations for the best restaurants or cafés where we locals go in Wroclaw, or maybe our planning guides where you can find useful information about getting into Wroclaw and some pre-selected accommodations where we normally put our friends and family if we don‘t have enough space…

What also might be interesting in this context for you is our free self-guided walking tour through Nadodrze, a district where you can still find a lot of old German traces:

Check out our self-guided walking tour

Signs of History: German traces in Nadodrze

This walk isn't built around famous sights, it's a hunt for something the city spent decades trying to erase. After…
